priorityList: Use Muzzle to interrupt spellcasting as needed.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are outside of melee range to continue attacking.
Activate Takedown along with your trinkets and racial abilities for your primary burst window.
Use Kill Command if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear and any Pack Leader buff (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear) is active.
Use Kill Command if Takedown is nearly off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Takedown if you have Tip of the Spear stacks (or at 0 stacks if talented into Twin Fangs).
Cast Wildfire Bomb if it is about to reach maximum charges to prevent capping.
Use Boomstick whenever you have a Tip of the Spear stack active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb whenever you have a Tip of the Spear stack active.
Use Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or if your Raptor Swipe cleave buff is missing.
Use Kill Command as your primary generator for Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks.
Cast Wildfire Bomb as a filler if no other high-priority actions are available.
Use Takedown whenever it becomes available if not already used.
